big_case.notes: Pro se section 1983 suit against two Kentucky state judges in their official capacities, arising from a private foreclosure. The abstract question (whether Caperton/Williams due-process disqualification limits absolute judicial immunity) has some doctrinal interest, but this vehicle was independently barred (Eleventh Amendment, section 1983 injunction proviso), the theory was unpreserved, the decision below was unpublished, and the petition conceded no square split. Denied without comment after a single distribution, with no amicus, CVSG, or separate writing. Low stakes.
